name: Rehearse a return (no refund)
description: Opens HCDEV#5860 on the iPad, selects both lines, sets a different restock choice, return reason and note on each, reads every setting back off the screen, reads the cart's refund total and opens the refund-method chooser, then clears the cart. Nothing is tendered and no refund is issued. Use it to prove a return plan will run before spending a real refund on finding out it will not.
